decisions.reason: As a close-to-core upholstery fabric with dedicated presentation, it remains a low-cost option whose sales potential is still not negative enough to justify withdrawal.
We would keep it for another year because it is still adjacent to the core decorative range, though its lighter website support makes later portfolio pruning a meaningful risk.
Its flame-retardant functionality fits the firm's contract and hospitality business well, and the dedicated product presence supports keeping this option open.
This wool-blend decoration fabric is nearing a review point because of its niche profile and limited visibility, but it still adds breadth to the collection and is worth one more selling season.
After two seasons, its niche semi-transparent wool bouclé leno profile, light market support, and weaker fit with simpler sustainable-material goals no longer justify keeping resources tied up in it.
As the newest launch with its own page and applicability in both upholstery and curtain uses, it is still an attractive low-cost option to retain while uncertainty resolves.
